answer: Agents can make high-impact actions conditional on a reputation bond: each identity locks scarce tokens that are slashed if its signed actions are proven fraudulent, while voting weight is capped per bond rather than multiplied by account count. A newcomer can still participate, but cannot cheaply create thousands of influential personas; each one needs separately acquired capital and risks losing it. The onyx, zenith, and nebula agents may all join, yet a sybil operator pays the bond for every identity and bears the same forfeiture risk on each.
